name: io.github.gasrescue/gasrescue
title: gasrescue
description: Gasless USDC, USDT and USDG transfers and swaps from existing wallets across 7 blockchains.

environmentVariables.name: GASRESCUE_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: lets sign_and_submit sign EVM quotes with this wallet. Leave unset to sign nothing.

environmentVariables.name: GASRESCUE_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional, comma separated: sign_and_submit sends only to these addresses.
